notes: Checkpoint 7.1 cache test workload. Eight original questions with known answers in the corpus (from the simple one-hop suite and the benign set). Each has an exact repeat and a paraphrase, which should be served from the cache, and some have a near-miss: a question that looks similar but has a different answer, which must never be served the original's answer. Near-misses change a number (caught by the number guard) or ask for a different attribute of the same subject (the hard case for a similarity threshold). Requests are issued in this order.
